package.name: autonomous-drone-flight-controller-mfg
package.scope: Flight-controller build package. Software-complete and audited; every fabrication, image and per-unit item is gated by a named requirement or facility blocker. Audit: 12_manufacturing/tools/audit_release_manifest.py, run as a regression step.

EDA_TOOLCHAIN.blocker: no schematic/PCB CAD tool in this workspace: no layout, gerber, drill, pick-and-place or drawing can be produced, so the fabrication half of MFG-001 cannot exist
EDA_TOOLCHAIN.resolved_when: an approved layout source exists and its fabrication export is digest-pinned in this manifest
EDA_TOOLCHAIN.evidence: 12_manufacturing/fabrication/FABRICATION_DATA_SPEC.md; PCB_CONSTRAINTS.md records 'No EDA toolchain available in this environment'

STM32_TOOLCHAIN.blocker: no arm-none-eabi-gcc on this host: the shared application has never been compiled for the STM32 target, so no releasable image exists
STM32_TOOLCHAIN.resolved_when: the stm32 target builds and the image is placed in 12_manufacturing/release/ and pinned here
STM32_TOOLCHAIN.evidence: run_regression.sh hardware step reports SKIP (arm-none-eabi-gcc not installed)

BOARD.blocker: no flight-controller board exists: pre-power checks, power-up, sensor bring-up, motor-off DShot validation, failsafe verification and every per-unit QC record are unexecuted

THRUST_STAND.blocker: no measured motor/prop thrust or current data: motor, propeller, ESC and battery remain class-selected because their class cannot be confirmed against the mass and endurance budget (SYS-007)
THRUST_STAND.resolved_when: a thrust/current measurement record exists and the pins are locked in CONTROLLED_BOM.csv
THRUST_STAND.evidence: 01_hardware/00_system/POWER_BUDGET.md (hover power and mass budget); CONTROLLED_BOM.csv rows MFG-BOM-12..15

version_bindings.name: telemetry_schema_fc
version_bindings.note: binary status record schema the FC emits (v2 added the safety action byte)

version_bindings.name: telemetry_schema_gs
version_bindings.note: a decoder behind the encoder is how a fleet loses its telemetry silently

version_bindings.name: cmd_gate_version
version_bindings.note: inbound command frame version the FC will accept

version_bindings.name: param_blob_version_fw
version_bindings.note: version written by params_defaults() in the firmware

version_bindings.name: param_blob_version_released
version_bindings.note: the blob in the package must be the blob the firmware currently defines

items.purpose: the BOM a build is released against; unpinned rows carry a gate
exact bytes params_store() writes, generated from the firmware's own defaults
layout and values the audit re-derives independently from the blob
export contract and acceptance for gerbers/drill/pick-and-place/stencil
accept/reject criteria traceable to approved constraints
assembly order, IMU-zone rules, pre-power gate
programming, serial scheme, PT-0..PT-7 with per-station gate
21-line release checklist with evidence or gate per line

items.reason: a gerber is a projection of a layout; no layout exists, and fabricating one from prose would be worse than shipping nothing
placement must come from the approved layout, not from a hand-made table
paste reduction for the QFN/LGA pads is a layout property
a drawing and a STEP model are outputs of the layout
the toolchain that produces the image is absent; FW-001's SIM build is MET and is not a substitute for a target image
a test record requires a unit; PT-1's record is the regression log and is not per-unit
Phase 28 owns the operational release: FRR sign-off, motor-off bench pass, geofence and RC-failsafe verification
